articles.summary: (NASDAQ: FBNC) , announced the opening of its new SouthPark branch and office, marking an important milestone for the bank and a significant investment in its continued growth in Charlotte. "Charlotte has been an important part of First Bank's growth, and our investment in SouthPark reflects our long-term commitment to this market," said Adam Currie, CEO of First Bank. "We've assembled an exceptional team here and built strong relationships with the clients and communities we serve. This new location gives our team greater resources to serve our clients, pursue new opportunities and strengthen our position in the market." That momentum is backed by strong financial performance and national recognition. In 2026, First Bank was named to Forbes' inaugural list of the World's Top Performing Banks, which evaluates financial institutions using objective measures including profitability, growth and earnings quality, capital and funding resilience, and asset quality and efficiency.
